svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Session startup, sign-out and identity change in the SPA
svg.desc: Session startup, sign-out and identity change in the SPA. 13 components in 2 groups. Connections: App loads to Stored access token?; Stored access token? to GET /api/auth/me (yes); Stored access token? to endSession (no); GET /api/auth/me to Verify token, load user; Verify token, load user to Profile verified? (profile or 401); Profile verified? to Prefetch core data (yes); Profile verified? to endSession (no); Prefetch core data to Serve authenticated requests; Serve authenticated requests to Identity changed? (auth store changes); Identity changed? to clearSessionData (yes); Identity changed? to Serve authenticated requests (no); clearSessionData to Serve authenticated requests (new identity continues); Serve authenticated requests to POST /api/auth/logout (user signs out); POST /api/auth/logout to Bump token_version; Bump token_version to endSession (on settle or error); endSession to Signed out.

text.tspan: SESSION STARTUP, SIGN-OUT AND IDENTITY CHANGE IN THE SPA
A stored token is verified with /api/auth/me, an identity change clears session data, and every sign-out goes through endSession
